title: Don't be a meat proxy

action: Check if you're a meat proxy in your own workflow

title: Prevent cognitive debt by manually retyping LLM-generated code
why_it_matters: 363 HN upvotes for a counterintuitive thesis: manually retyping AI-generated code builds the mental model you need to debug it later. A practical antidote to copy-paste driven development that resonates with developers feeling the cognitive debt pile up.
action: Try the retype-then-commit workflow on your next AI-generated feature

title: What's the largest software project AI can complete on its own?
